messages:
Maya (Sales): hey team, quick one — prospect wants BYOK with HSM-backed keys, plus SIG/CAIQ proof points. they asked about rotation windows, import/export rules, and what attestations we can provide. need short canned answers for the RFP.
Alex (SecOps): sure. short version: we support envelope encryption with a customer-managed master key. you can either: 1) use our managed KMS with the master key wrapped by the customer's KMS (KMIP/Cloud-KMS wrapping) or 2) bring your own key on a cloud HSM (CloudHSM/Dedicated HSM) or on-prem HSM via our private deployment. plaintext keys are never exported.
Priya (Solutions): notable quick bullets for SIG/CAIQ: Key management controls (KME): we maintain separation of duties, role-based access, audit logging for all key operations, MFA for key admins, and HSM-backed key material for BYOHSM flows. provide SOC 2 Type II & ISO 27001 as attachments.
Maya (Sales): what about rotation policy? the customer wants specifics (freq, overlap, rollback).
Alex (SecOps): defaults: data keys (DEK) rotated automatically on usage patterns — recommend 30 days; master keys (KEK) rotation supported but typically annual and requires rewrap. we support automatic key versioning and a configurable grace period (e.g., 7 days) so tokens signed with old keys stay valid while systems migrate. emergency rotation workflow: immediate key disable, re-encrypt active data keys, notify customer and run replay migration; we keep immutable key versions for auditing.
Priya (Solutions): implementation notes to include in the RFP reply: - Envelope encryption: DEKs generated per object/session, encrypted with KEK. - KEK never leaves HSM in BYOHSM and is only wrapped when using cloud KMS wrap. - All transit uses TLS1.2+ with mutual TLS for private deployments. - Audit logs are retained for 1 year by default; extended retention available.
Maya (Sales): they asked for proof of HSM certs (FIPS). do we provide FIPS/HSM cert info?
Alex (SecOps): we can state: our supported HSM providers (e.g., AWS CloudHSM, Azure Dedicated HSM, on-prem PKCS#11 devices) are FIPS 140-2/3 validated per vendor attestation. we include vendor certs and HSM firmware versions in the attestation package. note: Redwood itself is SOC 2 Type II and ISO27001; we don't claim HSM vendor validation beyond vendor-supplied proofs.
Priya (Solutions): sample one-liner for the SIG/Q: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys via cloud HSM or on-prem HSM. Master keys are HSM-resident and never exported in plaintext. We provide vendor HSM attestations and internal SOC2/ISO artifacts on request under NDA."
Maya (Sales): any CLI/console snippet we can paste into the RFP to show how BYOK works? short example would be helpful.
Alex (SecOps): paste this small example (keep it high-level):
```
# Upload a wrapped KEK (customer wraps with their KMS)
redwood keys import --wrapped-key-file my_kek.wrapped --wrap-alg rsa-oaep
# Or initiate cloud-hsm binding
redwood keys bind-hsm --provider aws-cloudhsm --cluster-id hsm-cluster-123
```
Add link to docs: <https://redwood.example.com/docs/security/key-management>
Priya (Solutions): also note CAIQ field answers: - Encryption at rest: AES-256-GCM with HSM KEK wrapping. - Encryption in transit: TLS1.2+ with forward secrecy. - Key rotation: configurable, default DEK 30d, KEK annual; configurable overlap windows. - Key destruction: support scheduled deletion with recovery window; for BYOHSM owner controls key lifecycle.
Maya (Sales): last one — they want to know if we can do attestations for vendor risk (SIG) directly to their third party risk team.
Alex (SecOps): we can provide a completed SIG/CAIQ, SOC2 Type II report extract, and HSM vendor attestations. legal/security will sign an NDA and provide an artifacts bundle. for live POCs requiring attestation, we'll do a short onboarding call with their risk team and provide a tailored package.
Priya (Solutions): TL;DR answer for RFP: "Redwood offers HSM-backed BYOK with envelope encryption, rotation controls (configurable with safe overlap), non-export of plaintext keys, vendor HSM attestation, SOC2/ISO artifacts, and an emergency key rotation + rollback playbook. Contact sec@redwood.com for artifacts and NDA." :thumbsup:
